NO generation bump: nothing under Pl/ or cl/ changed but comments, and
`tools/corpus-diff.pl d65f4a7c` is emission-IDENTICAL across 111 files
(silent drops 5, unchanged; 6 shape files identical).

THE MOVE.  git mv runt clt sweep-perl-tests.pl -> tools/; git rm
run-perl-test.pl.  Root keeps pcl, pl2cl, runpcl, xs-pin.  Root derivation one
level up in each script's OWN idiom (NOT PCLPaths::root() -- that is #1302's,
and a second resolver here is what #1302 exists to remove):
  tools/runt, tools/clt          dirname(abs_path(dirname($0)))
  tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl      use lib "$FindBin::RealBin/lib"  and
                                 $project_root = dirname($FindBin::RealBin)
                                 (abs_path dropped from the Cwd import -- line
                                 59 was its only user)
The moved sweep differs from the old in exactly FOUR lines (usage comment, Cwd
import, use lib, root derivation).  `git diff --summary d65f4a7c HEAD` is one
line: the deletion of run-perl-test.pl.

REFERENCES.  Scope RULED by Fable this session: LIVING documents only.  Dated
past-session plan docs (docs/plan-*-sNNN.md and the *-plan.md family),
docs/history/, docs/session-log.md, docs/DECIDED.md and the baselines/*.tsv
header notes KEEP their old spellings -- they record what was run then, and
re-spelling them falsifies a measurement's provenance.  Same reason keeps
CLAUDE.md's compressed-history bullet 2i while its four LIVE paths move.
  16 new spellings in 11 code/config files (measured vs d65f4a7c): cl/pack-impl.pl, tools/rebuild-pack
  (x2), Pl/t/artifact-staleness-01.t and .claude/settings.json's two permission
  strings are runnable commands; pl2cl, cl/pcl-test.lisp (x2),
  tools/run-perl-suite.pl (x3), tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm, tools/lib/PCLProc.pm,
  tools/lib/PCLShortfall.pm, tools/sweep-diff.pl are comments.
  54 in 13 live docs, plus 14 run-perl-test.pl mentions replaced: CLAUDE.md (4), README.md, docs/STATUS.md,
  test-debugging-runbook, test-skip-registry, sweep-bug-catalog,
  perl-test-suite-coverage, test-infrastructure, test-failures-categorized,
  bug-finding-strategy, todo-features, pexpr-term-parsing-review,
  debugging-hangs-crashes.
  Two comments deliberately keep the bare basenames because they name files
  INSIDE tools/ and read correctly there: tools/dup-census.pl:98 and
  Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t:51.  That test's @FILES is now qw(pl2cl runpcl);
  the three are reached through @DIRS' `tools` (File::Find recurses), so the
  scanned COUNT is unchanged.  dup-census gains `runt clt` and deliberately NOT
  sweep-perl-tests.pl (glob tools/*.pl already has it, and default_files does
  not deduplicate) -- verified 65 files, 0 duplicates, 0 root leftovers.
  tools/install-pcl unaffected (@TREE = pl2cl runpcl Pl lib cl tools/lib).
  docs/debugging-hangs-crashes.md needed more than a re-spelling: it was written
  around run-perl-test.pl and tools/runt differs exactly where it made claims
  (runt writes /tmp/<name>.out rather than a backtick, MERGES stderr into it
  rather than swallowing it, and already HAS the per-test timeout the doc's
  wishlist asked for -- RUNT_TIMEOUT, 300 s default).  Same for
  test-infrastructure.md and the three bug-finding-strategy.md recipes.

BARS, all met.
* Gate PCLXS_DIR=~/pclxs tools/prove-core: Files=213, Tests=7347; the ONLY
  failures are the 13 standing pclxs xs rows (xs-01 5, xs-02 4, xs-03 4).
  no-hardcoded-paths-01.t, license-tag-01.t, artifact-staleness-01.t all ok.
* corpus-diff d65f4a7c: IDENTICAL over 111 files.
* PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 byte-identical, the moved sweep vs the old one on a
  `git archive d65f4a7c` extraction: ZERO differences on THREE legs -- cached
  core, PCL_NO_CORE=1 (no core at all), and the control of the OLD runner run
  twice.  Normalised only root-derived or run-derived fields: the tree root; the
  core file's PATHKEY, which IS sha1(abs runtime path)[0,8] (PCLSbcl
  cached_core) while its SOURCE hash 9108d969a545 matched on BOTH sides; and

  varying from itself.
* tools/runt loopctl vs ./runt loopctl: stdout BYTE-IDENTICAL RAW (3348 bytes);
  /tmp/loopctl.lisp byte-identical after the five root strings its preamble
  embeds by design (#217); stderr likewise; /tmp/loopctl.out byte-identical
  after stripping SBCL's own {HEXADDR} object addresses -- which the SAME runner
  on the SAME tree varies from itself run to run (measured: 6 lines, identical

* .faillog LOCATION: at the PROJECT root after a one-file run, no
  tools/.faillog, and still the project root when invoked with cwd=/tmp.
* FULL SWEEP `perl tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl --jobs 4`: GATE clean, 0 new /

  extraction (--jobs 4, after mine): the two .faillog/_status.tsv are

  serial re-run was owed.
* tools/tag-license --check exit 0; tools/rebuild-pack --help exit 0 and its
  message path re-spelled; tools/dup-census.pl runs.

WHAT THE GATE CAUGHT (worth remembering).  The reference rewrite wrote each file
as <path>.new and renamed it into place -- safe for content, silently WRONG for
MODE: the new file is created at 0666 & ~umask, so pl2cl, tools/rebuild-pack,
tools/run-perl-suite.pl and tools/sweep-diff.pl went 100755 -> 100644 and the
gate's first row said `sh: 1: ./pl2cl: Permission denied`.  Restored and amended
into the same commit.  `git diff --summary <base> HEAD | grep mode` is the cheap
check after any scripted file rewrite -- plain `git diff` shows nothing for it.

NOT DONE HERE (by design): memory reference_runt_script.md and
.claude/settings.local.json are Fable's after the merge; PCLPaths::root() is

`## s471b`.  Task IDs 1310-1314 were reserved and NOT used -- nothing new was
found to file.
